serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: O-oh yeah, I think Mr Landlord told me something about it.
Policewoman: Mr Landlord?
You: Yeah, guy who owns this place, He lives in the biggest apartment here.
Policewoman: We will talk to him for sure.
Policewoman: What exactly did he tell you about?
You: He was talking about some weird girl, I didn’t ask for details, sorry!
Policewoman: Alright, that will be all for now. Have a nice day.
You: Y-you too.
